result.summary: The page is mostly polished, but a few elements look clipped or overlapped, especially around horizontally scrolling sections and the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the feed content. The second restaurant card/image is partially hidden behind the bottom tab bar, making the content feel cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or safe-area spacing to the scrollable content so cards can scroll fully above the bottom navigation.

issues.description: The category chip carousel is cut off on the right edge, leaving a partially visible blank pill with no readable label.
issues.suggestion: Ensure partially visible carousel items still show enough content to indicate they are scrollable, or add right padding/fade treatment to make the clipping feel intentional.

issues.description: The horizontal restaurant carousel under “Fastest near you” shows the third card heavily clipped at the right edge, including truncated restaurant text.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent card spacing and a visible carousel affordance, or align the partial card so it looks intentionally scrollable rather than accidentally cropped.
